observations: All four recovered25 normal hometown ordinals have a finite ordered route and zero unresolved map floors in the selected witness.
Classic coordinate routes for ordinals 1,2 succeed; classic-only ordinals 3,4 fail with a disconnected source component.
Ordinal 3 order is COMBAT>SHOP>WARPMAN; ordinal 4 is SHOP>COMBAT>WARPMAN; both rely on a normal affordable purchase and an ITEM FREE predicate.
One-hit/EXP and WarpMan outcomes are existential legal source witnesses; no universal win, guaranteed destination or efficient pace follows.
The 826 recovered25 floor set uses 761 DAT three-plane and 65 LS2MAP two-plane payloads. LS2MAP's missing event plane is not zero-filled.
The minimal battle settlement return is not proof of original server reward, quest award, login persistence or historical v1 content.
